sources.title: Introducing computer use, a new Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Claude 3.5 Haiku
sources.evidence: Dated October 22, 2024; announces the upgraded Sonnet available that day, improved coding and tool use, and experimental computer use. Identifies this as a new revision of Claude 3.5 Sonnet.

sources.title: Model Card Addendum: Claude 3.5 Haiku and Upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet
sources.evidence: The 14-page October addendum labels the exact revision Claude 3.5 Sonnet (New), describes image understanding and external function calls, and distinguishes typical models from models with extensive pre-response computation. It does not disclose production parameter counts or architecture.

sources.title: Raising the bar on SWE-bench Verified with Claude 3.5 Sonnet
sources.evidence: January 6, 2025 post explicitly discusses the upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet and states its context length is 200k. Describes its text outputs and Bash/Edit tool use in the evaluation scaffold.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes
sources.evidence: October 22, 2024 entry announces upgraded Sonnet and computer-use tools; November 1, 2024 entry adds PDF support to the new Sonnet 3.5; November 13 extends PDF support to all Sonnet 3.5 models.

sources.title: Partner model deprecations: Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 on Google Cloud
sources.evidence: The specific Sonnet v2 entry lists October 22, 2024 release, 200,000 context, text/code/image inputs, text output, function calling, and no extended thinking. This legacy specification is not evidence of current endpoint availability.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 and records its Claude API retirement on October 28, 2025, separately from the June 2024 snapshot.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet System Card
sources.evidence: Later first-party card includes exact Claude 3.5 Sonnet (new) comparison columns and training discussion; these report evaluations, not total or active parameter counts or the October model architecture.

sources.title: Claude 4 System Card
sources.evidence: Later first-party card includes Claude Sonnet 3.5 (new) comparisons. Inspected parameter/architecture references and exact-name comparisons do not supply production parameter counts or architecture for the October 2024 model.

sources.title: Developing a computer use model
sources.evidence: October 22 training research describes teaching the latest Sonnet 3.5 to interpret screenshots, count pixels and use software tools; it does not identify network architecture or parameter counts.

sources.title: On the Biology of a Large Language Model
sources.evidence: First-party interpretability research explicitly studies Claude 3.5 Haiku. Its internal mechanisms and feature counts cannot establish the architecture or parameter counts of the October Sonnet revision.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Used only for the general closed-weight distribution policy, not to transfer later models’ technical specifications.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The commercial terms govern access to Anthropic services and reserve intellectual property rights; they are service terms rather than an open model-weight license.

sources.title: Attempted legacy Claude 3.5 Sonnet documentation
sources.evidence: This candidate legacy model URL was inaccessible through the web tool. No claims depend on it; the release, research post and model card were accessible.

sources.title: Models.dev source record
sources.evidence: Read the baseline source link as a discovery lead. Its assertions are independently assessed against the primary sources above, rather than treated as verification.

sources.title: Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models
sources.evidence: October 29, 2025 first-party interpretability paper explicitly includes production Sonnet 3.5 (new), linking to the October 2024 release. Methods record and inject residual-stream activations at model layers; the introduction and discussion frame the studied models as transformer-based. It does not disclose parameter counts or dense/MoE subtype.

sources.title: Claude Model Pricing — List Prices by Platform, effective May 12, 2026
sources.evidence: Parent reviewed page3: the May12,2026 API pricing table lists 200K and 1M rows for Claude 3.5 Sonnet (without specifying June or October revision). These rows postdate Anthropic API retirement and conflict with retained exact-model context specifications; no corroborating availability announcement was found.

name.note: Retain the catalog display label: Anthropic calls this upgraded/new Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and the hosting-provider documentation calls the October revision Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2.

developer.note: Anthropic announces and authors the model and its model-card addendum.

family.note: Catalog normalization for the Claude Sonnet line; the addendum places this upgraded Sonnet within the Claude 3 family.

release_date.note: The dated announcement says the upgraded model is available that day; this is not inferred from the API identifier or the June release.

open_weights.note: The exact release is distributed through hosted services; Anthropic states that Claude weights are not publicly released. No public downloadable checkpoint was found.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary service-access classification supported by reserved intellectual property and explicit non-distribution of weights. The catalog permits this category, not just SPDX identifiers.

parameters_b.note: No total count is disclosed in the October card or the inspected later exact-name comparison material. Searches of first-party reports and training/interpretability research did not establish a count; no rumored size is adopted.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-parameter count is disclosed for this revision. It cannot be inferred from an unknown total or an assumed dense architecture.

architecture.note: Generic Transformer classification is supported by the first-party paper’s framing and residual-stream/layer methods applied explicitly to production Sonnet 3.5 (new); its model link resolves to the October release announcement. This is a source-based architectural classification, not a model self-description. Dense versus MoE, layer counts and other architectural details remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Anthropic explicitly states 200k context for the updated Sonnet in its January 2025 SWE-bench post; the separate provider v2 specification agrees. Last-documented capability, not a current availability claim. A later post-retirement pricing table also lists a conflicting 1M API tier; retain 200K from exact-model documentation because the pricing row does not establish feature availability.

modalities.note: Text/image understanding and text output are documented for v2. Anthropic added PDF input on November 1, 2024, after release; PDF is a supported API document format, not an additional underlying sensory modality.

reasoning.note: Interpreted as a dedicated extended-thinking API mode, which the v2 specification explicitly does not support. This does not deny ordinary reasoning ability or prompted chain-of-thought.

tool_call.note: The October card explicitly describes external function calls and computer-use tool calls; the dated API release notes confirm support.

description.value: October 2024 update of Claude 3.5 Sonnet with text and image understanding, improved coding and tool use, and experimental computer-use support.
description.note: Replace the vague balanced/cost-control description with revision-specific documented behavior. Improved coding and tool use are relative to its predecessor; computer use was experimental at launch.

patch.description: October 2024 update of Claude 3.5 Sonnet with text and image understanding, improved coding and tool use, and experimental computer-use support.

sources.label: Anthropic later pricing table with conflicting context tier

patch.notes: The October 2024 revision is distinct from claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620. First-party interpretability research supports a generic Transformer architecture; dense/MoE subtype and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed. PDF input was added on November 1, 2024. Reasoning=false denotes no extended-thinking mode. Anthropic retired this API snapshot on October 28, 2025; listed capabilities are historical specifications. A May 12, 2026 pricing PDF lists a conflicting 1M API tier after retirement; retained exact-model specifications support 200K.

summary: Reviewed all 14 fields for the October 2024 snapshot. Confirmed release date, 200k context, text/image/PDF input, text output, function calls and absence of extended thinking. Added generic Transformer architecture based on later first-party interpretability research explicitly naming Sonnet 3.5 (new), and replaced the generic description and catalog-only provenance. Total/active parameters and dense/MoE subtype remain undisclosed after later exact-name system-card comparisons and research checks. No June or sibling specifications were transferred. No account usage limit prevented this audit.
